The role will be responsible for managing day-to-day Accounts Receivable operations, including billing, invoicing, receipt allocation, reconciliations, AR reporting, issue resolution, and client communication. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting knowledge, advanced Excel skills, analytical ability, and prior supervisory experience. Responsibilities Manage day-to-day Accounts Receivable activities, including email management and receipt allocation. Handle payroll-related invoicing and prepare AR performance reports. Support month-end and year-end closing activities while ensuring adherence to accounting standards and internal controls.
